detail.longDescription:
A critical vulnerability in the Linux kernel’s TCP implementation has been
assigned a CVSS score of 9.8, impacting multiple distributions including Ubuntu
and Red Hat. The flaw involves improper handling of TCP connections and could
allow remote attackers to cause denial-of-service conditions. The issue is being
tracked by major Linux vendors and patches are available in upstream kernel and
distribution repositories. Users are advised to update their systems promptly.
